verdict.rationale: Flagsmith Experimentation collects events from your application into a managed data warehouse and analyses results with a built-in Bayesian engine, so results come from your own ingested event data. However, the warehouse is Flagsmith-managed rather than your own, and no evidence shows how metrics are defined or whether they can be built from your own warehouse tables. Missing for 10: warehouse-native metrics on customer-owned tables, documented metric-definition workflow (SQL or event-based metric builder), transparency into how metrics are computed, independent corroboration.
